name: Abinadab (from Kiriath-jearim)
title: The Man Who Housed the Ark of the Covenant
summary: Abinadab lived in Kiriath-jearim, and the Lord's ark of the covenant stood in his house for twenty years after the Philistines had returned it. His sons Uzza and Ahio drove the cart when David later retrieved it.

keyEvents.title: Houses the Ark of the Covenant
keyEvents.description: The ark of the covenant was brought to Abinadab's house in Kiriath-jearim, where it remained for many years.
